answer.question: What does TEAM International do for travel and hospitality companies?
answer.text: TEAM International is a travel software development company that builds and modernizes the systems airlines, travel companies, hotel suppliers and event operators run on: booking and B2B platforms, hospitality operations and procurement, event platforms, and data. Lufthansa Group relies on our teams to add new booking capabilities to a 25-year-old core.
answer.segmentsIntro: Travel hospitality services companies of mid-size and enterprise scale that need engineering in their time zone.

focus.title: Travel and hospitality solutions we build and run

items.title: Booking, B2B and airline platforms

delivery.title: Your language, your market, your time zone
delivery.text: North American travel and hospitality companies work with our Medellín delivery center; European clients work with our teams in Ukraine. All locations are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and we work under GDPR.

items.q: What does a travel software development company do?
items.a: A travel software development company designs, builds, integrates and supports the software travel and hospitality businesses run on: booking engines, B2B and distribution platforms, apps, operations systems and data. TEAM International offers travel software development services and travel and hospitality IT solutions for airlines, travel companies, hotel suppliers and event operators.

items.q: Can you add new features to our legacy reservation or airline system?
items.a: Yes. For Lufthansa Group we build new B2B booking capabilities outside a 25-year-old monolith with micro-frontends and new services, so the old system keeps running while new features ship. Airline IT solutions rarely need a full replacement to move forward.

items.q: Do you integrate with GDS and travel APIs?
items.a: Yes. We build integrations with distribution systems, payment providers and partner APIs as part of booking and B2B platforms, and test them before every peak season.

items.q: Do you work with hotels and hospitality suppliers?
items.a: Yes. Our hospitality work includes an AI system for a hotel furniture and equipment supplier that cut operating costs by more than 63%, plus custom operations software. We focus on hospitality technology solutions that remove manual work.

items.q: Do you build software for events and venues?
items.a: Yes. We develop the core platform and data platform of a company that produces large-scale sports and entertainment events, and e-commerce for an event-rental business.

items.q: How is AI used in hospitality today?
items.a: AI in hospitality is everywhere but rarely deep. Wyndham's 2026 Owner Trends Report found that 98% of hotel owners have begun using AI, but only 32% have it embedded across most operations, and 40% cite integration with legacy systems as a barrier. Integration work comes first.

items.q: Do you work with mid-size travel companies?
items.a: Yes. Mid-size travel, hospitality and event companies are our focus; they get the same practices we use for Lufthansa Group.

With a Travel Discovery & Modernization Assessment. From there you choose a dedicated team, project delivery or support, including custom travel software development and travel technology solutions for a new product line.
